title: Puzzle Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: W2 batch-2 migration of the 🧩️puzzle plugin: merge its 22 constitutional Rust crates (3 apps ◻2d/🧊️3d/🖐️5d × 6 module crates + 3 app facade crates + 1 bundle/manifest crate) into ONE crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🧩️puzzle/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ with the full taxonomy source tree (artifacts/apps/modes/windows/panels/commands/options), per the master ticket's TEMPLATE.md recipe. Preserve the bundle crate's package name and all [package.metadata.*] tables verbatim. Verify with cargo check (native + wasm32-wasip2), clippy -D warnings, and cargo test with a wire-format byte-identical diff per app before deleting the old crates.
summary:
Merged 🧩️puzzle's 22 constitutional Rust crates (3 apps ◻2d/🧊️3d/🖐️5d × 6 module crates + 3 app facades + 1 bundle crate) into ONE crate `semio-s-plugin-puzzle` at `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🧩️puzzle/📦️packages/🦀️rust/`, with the full taxonomy source tree: 3 artifacts (one per app — the three schemas puzzle.2d/puzzle.3d/puzzle.5d are genuinely distinct, so no plugin-level 🫀️core was needed; 5d reaches 3d's engine via crate::artifacts::puzzle3d), 3 apps, 113 🦀️component.rs files, 29,017 Rust lines. All [package.metadata.*] tables preserved verbatim (component package semio:puzzle, 3 playground rows with unchanged ports 6012/6112, 6013/6113, 6014/6114, both asset rows, plus the 5d engine's wasm-pack wasm-opt=false).

VERIFICATION (all synchronous, all green): cargo check native 0 warnings; cargo check --target wasm32-wasip2 exit 0; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings exit 0; cargo test 377 passed / 0 failed (baselines were 2d 124, 3d 74, 5d 18 = 216; every old test carried over plus the previously-uncompilable ui-crate suites); cargo build --target wasm32-wasip2 + jco transpile succeeded (27.9 MB component, valid world). Wire format proven byte-identical for all three apps: a 26-row before/after dump (print_op | byte-length | hex for every Operation variant of all 3 apps plus all 4 Puzzle3dEngineCommand rows) diffs clean, and the capture is now frozen as permanent pinned-hex guards (artifacts/<a>/📡️spr wire_format_guard::operation_rows_keep_their_pre_migration_wire_bytes). Taxonomy audit clean: every 🦀️component.rs declared by a #[path] in 📦️lib.rs, no dangling paths, all 5 artifact component slots present per artifact, window dirs contain only allowed children, no "protocol" path segment or identifier remains.

app_commands! was deliberately NOT used: puzzle's three Command enums are macro_rules!-generated {window_id, args: serde_json::Value} shapes with a hand-written serde_json OpBinary, and args: Value is not DSL-representable — the macro would have silently rewritten the wire format. Each puzzleNd_command_variants! macro, variant list, order and action-id literals were kept byte-identical; only handle_action_impl's match body was decomposed across 🎮️commands/<group>/🦀️component.rs files. This finding is now TEMPLATE.md §5.1.

PRE-EXISTING BUGS FIXED (all independent of the migration): (1) the 2d engine's build.rs icon table was dead because the metabolism SVG assets had been renamed with a 🔣️ emoji prefix — stems are now trimmed to the bare catalog key; (2) the 2d and 5d default manifests carried "color": "var(--muted-foreground)", which the board host's hex/hsl-only validator rejects — replaced with the concrete #7b827d that token resolves to; (3) the nakagin fixture no longer carries meta.kindCatalogs (catalogs moved to the manifest registry), so a fill test loaded empty catalogs — a new catalogs_json_from_manifest_id() testkit helper reads them from mathematical_graph_manifest instead; (4) the 3d engine's tests still built scale fields with serde_json::json! after the lib migrated to dsl::DslValue (5 sites, crate did not compile); (5) the systemic repo-wide Ok(-wrapping corruption (TEMPLATE §12.3) hit 2d-ui (4 errors: missing Ok() wrap, Fault-vs-String return, encode_envelopes(&Vec<u8>)) and 5d-ui (6 errors: five `Ok(Emit::default();` unbalanced parens plus a missing Ok() wrap on DocumentApp::handle) — 3d-ui had only the Fault-vs-String one and none of the paren corruption.

REGISTRAR HANDOFF — remove root Cargo.toml member lines 38-59 (all 22 old puzzle members) and add "✏️s/🔌️plugins/🧩️puzzle/📦️packages/🦀️rust"; remove [workspace.dependencies] lines 541-543 (semio-s-app-puzzle-2d/-3d/-5d). Five external dependents must be repointed (two are hard [dependencies] on FRAMEWORK crates, not just demonstrator): 🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🗺️surface/🎲️board-2d (puzzle_2d + puzzle_2d_engine), 🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/📺️renderer/🧑️‍🎨️engine/🧊️wgpu (puzzle_2d_engine), 🧰️framework/…/🗣️dsl/🧪️fixture-sweep ([dev-dependencies] puzzle_2d/_3d/_5d), and 🎪️demonstrator (puzzle_3d_ui). Demonstrator's symbols are now crate::apps::puzzle3d::{Puzzle3dPlayApp, create_puzzle3d_app, register_puzzle3d_exports}. Four wasm-pack npm packages disappeared with the old crates (@semio-tech/puzzle-{2d,3d,5d}-rs, @semio-tech/puzzle-3d-ui-rs); one live TS consumer remains at .storybook/stories/puzzle/3d/World.stories.tsx (frozen for this ticket, W3/W4 scope).
